company: CR_54 CROWN Arabia Can Company Ltd
description:
**Job Description:**

Summary:  
Lead the back-end production team to ensure efficient operation, high-quality output, and adherence to safety standards within CROWN Arabia Can Company Ltd. Oversee daily activities, optimize processes, and manage team performance to meet production targets.  
  
Responsibilities:  
\* Supervise and coordinate the daily activities of the back-end production team, including scheduling, task assignment, and performance monitoring.  
\* Ensure all production processes meet established quality control standards and specifications for can manufacturing.  
\* Implement and enforce company safety policies and procedures, conducting regular safety audits and addressing any hazards promptly.  
\* Troubleshoot production issues and machine malfunctions, escalating complex problems to maintenance or engineering as needed.  
\* Train new team members on operational procedures, safety protocols, and quality standards.  
\* Monitor production metrics, analyze data, and report on team performance and output to management.  
\* Identify opportunities for process improvement and efficiency gains, and contribute to their implementation.  
\* Maintain accurate production records, including downtime, output, and quality checks.  
\* Collaborate with other departments, such as front-end production, maintenance, and quality assurance, to ensure smooth workflow.  
\* Foster a positive and productive work environment, promoting teamwork and open communication.  
  
Qualifications:  
\* High school diploma or equivalent; associate's degree in a technical field or related discipline preferred.  
\* Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in manufacturing production, preferably in the can or packaging industry.  
\* At least 1-2 years of experience in a supervisory or team leader role.  
\* Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot production equipment.  
\* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate and lead a team.  
\* Demonstrated understanding of quality control principles and safety regulations in a manufacturing environment.  
\* Ability to read and interpret technical documents, schematics, and production specifications.  
\* Proficiency in basic computer applications (e.g., Microsoft Office Suite).  
\* Ability to work rotating shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, as required.

  

Crown Holdings, Inc. through it's subsidiaries, is a world leader in the metal packaging production process. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative and sustainable metal packaging solutions and products. Our clients are some of the largest and most respected companies in the world.  
  
Crown is dedicated to building a team of highly talented, dedicated, and driven individuals. It's an exciting time to join our business because Crown offers you the opportunity to grow and develop your skills in an expanding industry.  
  
Crown was founded with the goal of valuing and promoting sustainability and this vision continues to be essential to our long-term future.

  

Ready to go behind the scenes? With hundreds of maufacturing plants and 20,000+ employees worldwide, there’s a lot that goes into the design and production of Crown packaging.  
  
We serve a variety of markets including food, beverage, household, personal care, and more.  
  
Since we were founded in 1892, we’ve been on a mission to manufacture best-in-class  packaging while championing best-in-class teams.  
  
Together, we’re building something that lasts thanks to great products, made by great people.

**Must‑Have Experience :**

**Technical Skills**

    * **Export Insurance Declaration**

**Soft Skills**

**Job Description –  (KSA)**

**Role Purpose**

The **Export Specialist** is responsible for managing end‑to‑end export operations, ensuring full compliance with Saudi and international regulations, accurate documentation, timely shipment execution, and smooth coordination with internal teams, freight forwarders, and government authorities. The role supports both **land and sea exports**, including re‑export activities, and ensures accurate reporting and insurance compliance.

**🔹 Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Export Documentation & Compliance**

* Prepare and issue **Proforma Invoices** for export orders.
* Manage **Export Insurance Declarations** and ensure all shipments are covered as per company policy.
* Handle **SFDA notifications**, **Health Certificates**, and all required regulatory documents.
* Ensure full compliance with Saudi Customs, SFDA, Chamber of Commerce, and country‑specific export requirements.

**2\. Shipment Execution (Land & Sea)**

* Prepare **loading plans** and coordinate with warehouse, transporters, and freight forwarders.
* Arrange bookings for land and sea shipments and ensure timely dispatch.
* Follow up on container movements, transit updates, and delivery confirmations.
* Coordinate with transporters for cross‑border, and GCC re‑export shipments.

**3\. Export Legalization & Government Processing**

* Manage **Export Invoice Legalization**, **Certificate of Origin (COO)**, and **Health Certificate (HC)** issuance.
* Coordinate with Chamber of Commerce, Ministry of Commerce, and other authorities for document stamping and approvals.

**4\. Claims & Issue Resolution**

* Handle **export claims**, including shortages, damages, insurance claims, and documentation discrepancies.
* Coordinate with freight forwarders, insurance providers, and internal teams to close claims efficiently.

**5\. Reporting & Systems**

* Update and maintain the **Export Tracker** with shipment status, documentation, and delivery timelines.
* Process and verify **supplier/transporter invoices** (freight forwarders, express couriers, land transporters).
* Maintain and update **Smartsheet** for export operations, ensuring accuracy and visibility.
* Support monthly reporting for export KPIs, cost tracking, and performance dashboards.

**6\. Cross‑Functional Coordination**

* Work closely with Sales Operations, Warehouse, Finance, and Supply Chain teams to ensure smooth export flow.
* Support customers and distributors with shipment visibility, documentation, and regulatory requirements.

description:
**Eram Talent** is seeking a creative and technically skilled **IT Support Assistant – Graphic Design Background** to provide IT support services while delivering high-quality graphic design solutions for digital and print media. Reporting to the IT Supervisor/Operations Manager, the role supports the maintenance of IT systems, software, and documentation while creating visually engaging content that enhances internal and external communications. The successful candidate will assist with troubleshooting IT issues, maintaining data backups, preparing system documentation, and designing creative assets including presentations, brochures, social media graphics, advertisements, and other digital content. The ideal candidate has **3–5 years of relevant experience** in IT support with a strong background in graphic design.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Provide first-level IT support for hardware, software, and system-related issues.
* Assist in maintaining computer programs, applications, system documentation, and operational procedures.
* Design creative layouts using typography, color, imagery, and branding guidelines.
* Produce high-quality visual assets for print and digital platforms, including brochures, presentations, banners, social media graphics, advertisements, and marketing materials.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand project requirements and deliver creative solutions.
* Support website and digital content updates when required.
* Troubleshoot minor computer hardware, software, and network-related issues.
* Maintain data backups and support portal administration activities.
* Prepare reports, presentations, and documentation for management review.
* Assist senior IT personnel with software configuration, system maintenance, and technical support activities.
* Handle service requests, trouble reports, and documentation with minimal supervision.
* Ensure compliance with organizational IT policies, security procedures, and branding standards.
* Perform other related IT and creative support duties as assigned.

**Requirements**

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Graphic Design, Multimedia, or a related field.
* **3–5 years** of experience in IT support with a strong graphic design background.
* Proficiency in **Adobe Creative Suite** (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and other graphic design tools.
* Experience with Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint for presentation design.
* Basic knowledge of computer hardware, software installation, troubleshooting, and system support.
* Familiarity with website content management systems (CMS) and digital media is an advantage.
* Strong understanding of branding, typography, layout design, and visual communication.
* Excellent organizational and multitasking skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Experience supporting engineering, technical, or corporate environments is preferred.

Qiddiya Digital is seeking highly experienced and hands-on Expert of Software Engineer – Digital Platforms to take technical ownership of critical digital product domains across Qiddiya’s ecosystem.

This is a senior individual contributor role with strong technical authority. While the position has no direct line-management responsibility, it will provide technical leadership to vendor engineering teams and remain accountable for the quality, resilience, reliability, security, performance, and operational readiness of the assigned platform.

A key objective is to eliminate black-box delivery, retain critical knowledge within Qiddiya, and ensure Qiddiya remains in full control of its digital platforms.

* Take end-to-end technical ownership of the assigned digital domain.

* Define and maintain the target architecture, engineering standards, and technical roadmap.

* Provide hands-on technical leadership across design, implementation, integration, release, and production operations.

* Lead and challenge vendor engineering teams, ensuring compliance with Qiddiya Digital standards.

* Review and approve architecture, APIs, data models, integrations, code quality, and major technical decisions.

* Validate vendor deliverables using clear acceptance criteria and measurable technical evidence.

* Ensure solutions are resilient, reliable, scalable, secure, observable, maintainable, and cost efficient.

* Define and monitor technical KPIs, service-level objectives, availability, latency, recovery, and performance targets.

* Ensure appropriate automated testing, CI/CD controls, monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting are in place.

* Validate release plans, rollout strategies, rollback procedures, capacity testing, disaster recovery, and production readiness.

* Lead technical incident management, root-cause analysis, and permanent remediation.

* Identify and manage technical debt, architectural risks, recurring incidents, and operational weaknesses.

* Maintain architecture documentation, technical decisions, runbooks, and support procedures.

* Drive knowledge transfer and ensure Qiddiya can independently operate and evolve the platform.
* Promote reusable capabilities and common engineering practices across Qiddiya’s digital assets.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Extensive software-engineering experience in a Lead, Staff, Principal Engineer, Technical Lead, or senior architecture role.
* Strong hands-on engineering capability and the ability to challenge implementation-level decisions.

* Experience designing and operating large-scale, distributed, cloud-native, and highly available platforms.

* Experience with customer-facing digital products, commerce, payments, loyalty, identity, ticketing, mobile, or similar platforms.

* Strong knowledge of APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, distributed systems, data consistency, and failure recovery.

* Strong experience with resilience, observability, performance engineering, security, automated testing, CI/CD, and production operations.
* Proven experience overseeing vendors, system integrators, or outsourced engineering teams.

* Strong incident-management, root-cause-analysis, and problem-management experience.

* Strong communication, stakeholder-management, and technical decision-making skills.

The IT Change Manager is accountable for governing and facilitating the Change Management process across the organization, ensuring that all IT changes — from standard to emergency — are assessed, authorized, implemented, and reviewed in a controlled and risk-managed manner.  

This role protects the stability of IT services by preventing unauthorized or poorly planned changes from negatively impacting business operations. The IT Change Manager acts as a strategic advisor and process owner, working closely with technical teams, business units, and senior leadership to balance agility with governance.  

YOU WILL  

»       Own and operate the end-to-end Change Management process in alignment with ITIL best practices and organizational policy.  

»       Chair and facilitate the Change Advisory Board (CAB) and Emergency CAB (ECAB) meetings, ensuring effective risk assessment and authorization of changes.  

»       Review, evaluate, and approve or reject Request for Change (RFC) submissions based on risk, impact, and resource availability.  

»       Maintain the Change Schedule (Forward Schedule of Change — FSC) and coordinate change windows with operational teams.  

»       Assess the risk and business impact of proposed changes, ensuring appropriate mitigation strategies and rollback plans are in place.  

»       Identify conflicts, dependencies, and potential clashes between concurrent changes across infrastructure, applications, and services.  

»       Ensure changes align with organizational risk appetite and regulatory obligations.  

»       Communicate approved changes and their impact to all relevant stakeholders in a timely and clear manner.  

»       Act as the primary liaison between technical teams and business units during planned changes, upgrades, and service windows.  

»       Produce clear, concise Change Management reports and post-implementation reviews (PIRs) for leadership.  

»       Define, maintain, and continuously improve Change Management policies, processes, procedures, and templates.  

»       Ensure all change activities are properly documented, auditable, and compliant with governance and regulatory requirements.  

»       Identify and remediate unauthorized changes (change without authorization — CWA) and enforce process adherence.  

»       Collaborate with Incident and Problem Management to identify change-related incidents and prevent recurrence.  

»       Administer and optimize the Change Management module within the ITSM platform (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira SM, BMC Remedy).  

»       Produce KPI dashboards, trend analysis, and SLA performance reports for senior management.  

»       Drive automation and adoption of pre-approved and standard change models to increase operational agility  

  

  

### Requirements

»       TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THE ROLE YOU NEED  

   

»       Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent experience).  

»       Minimum 4–6 years of experience in IT Service Management, with at least 2 years in a dedicated Change Management role.  

»       ITIL Foundation certification (v3 or v4) mandatory; ITIL Change Management Practitioner or Managing Professional strongly preferred.  

»       Proven experience chairing CAB meetings and managing complex, high-risk change processes.  

»       Strong proficiency with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or BMC Remedy.  

»       Solid understanding of enterprise IT environments, including infrastructure, cloud, networking, and applications.  

»       Demonstrated ability to balance governance rigor with business agility in a fast-moving environment.  

»       Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.  

»       ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leader designation.  

»       Experience implementing Change Enablement in DevOps or CI/CD-driven environments.  

»       Familiarity with release management, deployment pipelines, and DevSecOps practices.  

»       Knowledge of regulatory frameworks such as ISO 20000, SOX, ISO 27001, or COBIT.  

»       Project Management certification (PMP, PRINCE2) is a plus.

RLB is seeking a highly capable and proactive Contracts Manager to support the commercial delivery of a major project (Post Contract). The role is responsible ensuring the effective implementation of contractual obligations, protection of the client's commercial interests, and successful delivery of contractual and commercial outcomes.

Acting as a trusted advisor, the Contract Manager provides strategic contractual guidance throughout project execution, managing variations, claims, Extension of Time (EOT) requests, commercial risks, dispute resolution, and contract close-out activities. The role requires strong client-facing capabilities and the ability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders, contractors, consultants, and project teams.

The successful candidate will demonstrate initiative, accountability, and urgency, with the ability to independently drive commercial activities through to completion.

**Key Responsibilities:**  

1.  **Procurement**
    
    1.  Collaborate with the Procurement team to manage the tender process from invitation through to tender clarification and submission
        
    2.  Evaluate technical and commercial tender submissions and prepare tender evaluation reports
        
    3.  Manage the tender evaluation of future contracts through to contract award
        
    4.  Coordinate contract execution and contract deliverables following award.
        

2.  **Contract Administration**
    
    1.  Administer and manage contracts throughout the project lifecycle from contract award to final account.
        
    2.  Interpret contract provisions and advise clients project delivery team on contractual rights, obligations, risks, and entitlements.
        
    3.  Ensure compliance with contract requirements, governance procedures, and contractual obligations.
        
    4.  Monitor contractor and consultant performance against contractual commitments.
        
    5.  Maintain comprehensive contract records, notices, correspondence, and contractual documentation.
        
    6.  Identify contractual issues and recommend appropriate mitigation and resolution strategies.
        

3.  **Change Management and Variations**
    
    1.  Lead the administration and management of variations, change orders, compensation events, and contract amendments.
        
    2.  Assess contractual entitlement relating to changes in scope, time, cost, and risk.
        
    3.  Review and prepare variation submissions and supporting documentation.
        
    4.  Negotiate variations and commercial agreements with contractors and consultants.
        
    5.  Maintain variation registers and monitor approval status and financial impacts.
        
    6.  Ensure all contractual notification requirements are satisfied within prescribed timelines.
        

4.  **Claims and Extension of Time (EOT) Management**
    
    1.  Manage the preparation, evaluation, and negotiation of contractual claims.
        
    2.  Assess contractor and consultant claims for contractual entitlement, substantiation, and compliance.
        
    3.  Review Extension of Time (EOT) submissions and associated delay analyses.
        
    4.  Evaluate claims relating to prolongation costs, disruption, acceleration, and additional payment entitlement.
        
    5.  Develop strategies to protect the client's commercial position
        
    6.  Maintain accurate claims records and supporting evidence.
        

5.  **Payment and Commercial Administration**
    
    1.  Support the administration of interim and final payment processes in accordance with contract provisions.
        
    2.  Review payment applications, assessments, certifications, and commercial entitlements.
        
    3.  Ensure contractual payment obligations and timelines are properly managed.
        
    4.  Support final account negotiations and commercial settlements.
        
    5.  Monitor the commercial implications of project decisions, changes, and risks.
        

6.  **Contractual Correspondence and Notices**
    
    1.  Draft, review, and issue contractual notices, responses, instructions, and formal correspondence.
        
    2.  Ensure contractual communications comply with contract requirements and applicable regulations.
        
    3.  Monitor contractual deadlines, notice requirements, and critical milestones.
        
    4.  Maintain effective document control and contractual correspondence records.
        
    5.  Advise project teams on contractual communication strategies to preserve contractual rights and entitlements.
        

7.  **Commercial Risk Management**
    
    1.  Identify, assess, and manage contractual and commercial risks throughout project execution.
        
    2.  Establish and maintain contractual risk registers.
        
    3.  Advise clients and project teams on risk allocation and contractual exposure.

As Pool/Beach Service Manager, I fully comprehend the vision of Six Senses to help people reconnect with themselves, others and the world around them, plus our values of local sensitivity and global sensibility, crafted experiences, emotional hospitality, responsible and caring, fun and quirky and pioneering wellness. By embracing the Six Senses vision and values, I will deliver an exceptional experience for guests and develop hosts to be the very best they can be.
Sustainability, Wellness and Out of the Ordinary experiences are at the core of everything we do at Six Senses. I will safeguard these pillars and its strategic planning and development and ensure all directives, practices and initiatives are implemented, embraced, adopted within the hotel/resort.
Duties and Responsibilities
As Pool/Beach Service Manager, I will assume full responsibility for the efficient operation of the Food & Beverage department to provide exceptional product and service within brand operating standards.
The duties and responsibilities will include:
• Keep up to date with industry trends, best practices and guest expectations to continually improve the pool, bar and beverage experience.
• Regularly review products, menus, amenities and service standards to ensure they remain relevant, innovative and aligned with Six Senses brand guidelines.
• Maintain a strong operational presence throughout service, ensuring LQA standards and Six Senses service standards are consistently followed and exceeded.
• Ensure the pool, bar and F&B areas are clean, properly equipped, well maintained and fully ready before opening to guests.
• Inspect guest orders, service areas, equipment and maintenance needs regularly, ensuring required actions are completed within the designated timeframe.
• Deliver an exceptional guest experience by greeting guests courteously, using guest names whenever possible, handling welcome and check-in procedures efficiently and ensuring prompt, attentive service.
• Handle guest feedback, inquiries, complaints and service recovery effectively; log comments, take appropriate action, follow up and escalate matters to the F&B Director when needed.
• Review daily arrivals and departures, ensuring proper handling of Special Guests, VIP Guests and Groups.
• Maintain and update guest history profiles, preferences, allergies, dietary requirements and recognition details, ensuring information is shared and implemented whenever possible.
• Maintain full knowledge of outlet menus, specials, wine lists, F&B activities and property facilities, and guide order taking, upselling and recommendations as required.
• Lead, schedule, train, coach and provide feedback to F&B hosts and supervisors, ensuring an engaged team that delivers Six Senses standards of service.
• Ensure clear communication within the department and with other departments to support smooth daily operations, including regular meetings, briefings and updates on policies, procedures, events, improvement plans and guest comments.
• Comply with and enforce the Management System requirements for quality, environment, health and safety, including recording and reporting required data, communicating deviations or incidents and participating in related training and awareness activities.
• Maintain high standards of safety, security, emergency readiness, personal appearance, grooming and hygiene for myself and all hosts, in line with brand and statutory requirements.
• Control inventory, stationery, stock levels, storage and monthly pool bar inventory, ensuring items are available, properly stored, reordered on time and aligned with hygiene and control standards.
• Assist in managing the outlet operational budget, monitoring costs, payroll productivity, scheduling and profitability while preserving required standards.
• Maintain efficient administration by preparing, submitting and completing operational, corporate, legal and confidential reports accurately and on time.
• Maintain vendor relationships.
• Ensure all activities are carried out ethically, honestly and within the parameters of local law.
• Remain flexible, self-motivated and calm under pressure, handling multiple demands, resolving issues quickly and performing any additional duties assigned by the leadership team or manager.
Qualifications
To execute the position of Pool/Beach Service Manager, I must have the required qualifications, technical skills and experience in a similar role in luxury hotels with proven results and includes the following:
• High school diploma or equivalent and at least 1-3 years restaurant management experience in a full-service outlet or similar setting. Hospitality Management Degree or some college preferred.
• Fluent in English
• Alcohol awareness certification and/or food service permit or valid health/food handler card as required by local or state government agency.

job_title: Associate Director, Legal & Compliance - Middle East
description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.  


Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.  


We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.  
  
**Job Description**  


Gilead is seeking an **Associate Director, Legal & Compliance–Middle East**, reporting to the Legal & Compliance Director ME, to lead and further embed a **best-in-class compliance program across the region**, while continuing to provide **high-quality legal support** to business operations in Middle East. The role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

This role combines strategic compliance leadership with pragmatic legal business partnering, with a strong emphasis on business conduct oversight and risk identification and mitigation across Middle East markets.

The role serves as a trusted compliance advisor to Commercial, Medical, Market Access and functional leadership teams and acts as a key driver of a strong culture of ethics and integrity (“tone from the top”). Key responsibilities include providing oversight and being accountable for day-to-day activities of Gilead KSA Affiliate and the Middle East Region, as well as transparency reporting, compliance monitoring, compliance risk assessment, employee and third-party compliance training, policy implementation, ensuring effective compliance oversight in cross-functional activities in all Middle East countries. The position will work closely with functional leaders to ensure full integration of compliance into business processes.

The ideal candidate will have prior experience counselling prescription pharmaceutical companies in Middle East.

**Key Responsibilities**

Compliance:

* Transparency Reporting: Ensure complete, accurate, and timely reporting of transfers of value and other required transparency data in Saudi Arabia and across relevant GCC markets. Administer the transparency reporting systems for the region, maintaining data quality and liaising with internal stakeholders to meet all local transparency and disclosure obligations. Advise on legal risks related to disclosure obligations and exercise sound judgment in assessing potential exposure.

* Business Compliance Monitoring & Compliance Reporting: Cooperate with the Business Compliance Monitoring Manager for Turkey & Middle East to conduct and oversee compliance monitoring activities (e.g., sampling events, sponsorships, grants, and other HCP/HCO interactions) and preparing required compliance reports to local health authorities and internal stakeholders. Help identify potential compliance risks or systemic issues through monitoring and audits, and work with relevant business functions to implement corrective actions arising out of local audits internally and for local vendors or business partners or distributors.
* Policy Implementation & Compliance Projects: Drive implementation of global and local compliance policies and procedures throughout the Middle East. Work on strategically important compliance projects (both local and regional), ensuring alignment with global compliance initiatives and local business needs. Participate in global or international compliance working groups and contribute to the development and enhancement of compliance monitoring programs at the local and international level.  Proven track record in championing transparency initiatives and compliance programs.
* Training & Communication: Develop and deliver compliance training and awareness programs for employees and relevant third parties within the Middle East (GCC). Training topics may include but are not limited to anti-bribery/anti-corruption, healthcare compliance, interactions with healthcare professionals (HCPs), organizations (HCOs) and public officials. Foster a strong “tone from the top” by supporting regular compliance communications and leading the Middle East Compliance Committee meetings.
* Advisory & Collaboration: Act as a trusted compliance advisor for business units (Commercial, Medical, Market Access, Government Affairs, etc.) in the Middle East. Provide guidance on moderately to highly complex compliance questions, ensuring business activities are planned and executed in line with Gilead’s compliance standards. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to integrate compliance considerations into key initiatives and decision-making processes.
* Risk Assessment & Mitigation: Conduct periodic compliance risk assessments across Middle East operations to evaluate business conduct, identify compliance gaps or emerging risks, and recommend mitigation strategies and lead remedial actions. Monitor changes in local laws and industry codes (e.g., new regulations in Saudi Arabia and other Middle Eastern countries), and lead the implementation of any required changes to ensure ongoing compliance.
* Third-Party Compliance Oversight: Manage compliance due diligence and oversight of third-party business partners (e.g., distributors, agents, vendors) in the Middle East region. Ensure effective processes for evaluating and mitigating third-party compliance risks, including anti-bribery, sanctions/trade compliance, and government interactions, in collaboration with other relevant teams.
* Other Duties: Serve as a lead to local compliance committees (such as Grant Review and Business Conduct Committees, among others) as appropriate. Lead or support additional compliance-related tasks and cross-functional projects in the Middle East region as assigned, especially those with strategic importance or significant complexity. Represent the company as a credible leader in meetings with key Government Departments/Health authorities when required.

**Legal:**

* In close partnership with the Legal Director, act as a business partner to Commercial, Medical, Market Access and functional teams in the Middle East, providing responsive, practical, and solution-oriented legal advice on a broad range of strategic and operational matters.

• Acting alongside the Legal Director, provide legal counsel across key areas of law, including corporate, healthcare regulatory, public procurement, competition/antitrust, data privacy, and commercial contracting, ensuring business activities comply with applicable laws and regulations.

• Supporting the Legal Director to draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of agreements and legal documents, including commercial contracts, distributor agreements, and strategic business arrangements, ensuring appropriate risk mitigation and alignment with company policies.

• Advise on legal aspects of interactions with healthcare professionals (HCPs), healthcare organizations (HCOs), patient groups, and government entities, ensuring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry codes.

• Provide legal support in internal investigations, audits, and enforcement matters, including assessing legal risks, advising on exposure, and supporting remediation strategies.

• Represent the company in interactions with government authorities and regulatory agencies, acting as a credible and trusted legal representative when required.

• Ensure robust legal governance across the Middle East affiliates, including supporting corporate matters, local entity compliance, and documentation requirements.

• Monitor and interpret legal and regulatory developments across Middle East jurisdictions and provide proactive, actionable legal guidance to the business.

• Develop and deliver legal training on key topics such as competition law and data privacy, or such other topics cascaded by the global teams, strengthening legal awareness across the organization.

**Knowledge, Experience and Skills:**

* Language Proficiency: Fluency in both Arabic and English (written and verbal) is required.
* Regulatory & Cultural Knowledge: Familiarity with the Middle East regional healthcare environment and regulatory landscape. Experience working with or within Saudi Arabian and GCC authorities or navigating local regulatory requirements is advantageous.
* Business Partnership: Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally and serve as a business partner. Demonstrated experience influencing and engaging with various departments (Commercial, Medical, Finance, etc.) to achieve compliance objectives while supporting business goals.
* Judgment & Integrity: Unwavering commitment to high ethical standards and integrity. Sound judgment with the ability to anticipate issues, identify compliance risks, and provide practical solutions that align with company values and compliance requirements. Must be able to independently, effectively, and practically formulate compliance strategies to advance business objectives while mitigating risk. Exercise judgment and independently determine and take appropriate action in the areas of monitoring and training where precedent may not exist. Ability to apply judgment to areas outside of core competency.
* Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Exceptional communication skills – able to distill complex compliance concepts into clear guidance and training for diverse audiences. Strong interpersonal skills to build trust and credibility with internal stakeholders at all levels.
* Analytical & Problem-Solving: Analytical mindset with an ability to interpret data and monitoring results to identify trends or gaps. Creative problem-solving skills to address compliance challenges and implement effective risk mitigation strategies.
* Organizational Skills: Resilient and organized with a systematic approach to managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Excellent project management capabilities, including leading projects or initiatives across different countries or functions.
* Teamwork & Leadership: A collaborative team player who leads by example. Capable of guiding non-attorney compliance staff or matrix teams, providing mentorship and oversight when needed, and driving projects to completion without direct authority.
* Continuous Learning: Self-motivated individual who stays up-to-date with evolving compliance and regulatory standards, and proactively updates internal practices and training materials.

**Education & Qualifications**:

* A Juris Doctorate or fully qualified legal credentials, fully admitted to practice law in the respective country or jurisdiction.

* **(3+ years) professional experience in biotech, pharmaceuticals or other highly regulated industries or law firms advising in relevant areas of practice, with particular emphasis compliance** matters across  ME countries.
* Ability to operate with a  high degree of autonomy.

* Strong business partnering attitude; the maturity and awareness to strike a balance between facilitating, enabling and challenging the business.
* Proven ability to partner with other departments to achieve company goals that cross multiple functions.
* Unwavering commitment to the highest ethical standards and integrity.
* Conversant with procedures and protocols of dealing with Saudi government and its dependencies.

**Personal Competencies and Behaviors:**

* Self-starter and life-long learner with a strong work ethic and excellent interpersonal skills who enjoys working collaboratively and cross-functionally on teams, as well as independently.
* Collaborative team player that leads by example.
* Operationally excellent with an organized and systematic approach to prioritization in tight deadlines.
* Excellent influencing, interpersonal and communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to network, engage and partner with other functions.
* Strong business judgment with proven ability to identify and address customer needs.
* Strong organizational and project management skills and proven analytical skills and sound judgment.
* Practical approach to problem-solving.
* Consistently demonstrate and adhere to Gilead’s Core Values and Leadership Commitments and create and inspire a team culture committed to the same.

description:

* Provide Level 2/Level 3 production support for IBM BAW/BPMS applications.

* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex production incidents affecting business process applications.
* Support Process Server, Process Center, and deployment environments.

**About Telnyx**

*Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a* [*private, global, multi-cloud IP network*](https://telnyx.com/our-network)*, to bringing* [*hyperlocal edge*](https://telnyx.com/resources/about-edge-connectivity) *technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.*

*We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.*

*Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.*

  
  
**The Role**  
  
We're building a local Enterprise Sales Pod in Riyadh — one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in your market. You'll embed directly with enterprise customers to architect and ship production systems on Telnyx's global network — voice, messaging, AI, and wireless.  
  
This isn't about demoing products. It's about building real solutions that work at scale.  
  
You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated Enterprise AE — not a demo resource, but a commercial partner who owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, and closes the deal. You own the technical side: discovery, architecture, POC, and production go-live. You win together. No throw-over-the-wall.  
  
*The Pod Model*  
  
*Enterprise AE* — owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account.  
  
*Forward Deployed Engineer* — owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload.  
  
We sell the workload, not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu.  
  
**What You'll Do**  
  
• Embed with enterprise customers to understand their communications workflows, AI use cases, and integration challenges firsthand  
• Build and deploy custom implementations: AI Voice Assistants, Telnyx APIs (Voice, Messaging, Fax, Wireless), WebRTC  
• Run open-weight LLMs in customer environments — consume GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen, and MiniMax through Telnyx Inference (OpenAI-compatible API; there's no model infrastructure for you to run), or deploy self-hosted stacks (Llama, Mistral, and region-specific models like Jais, ALLaM, or other Arabic-language sovereign models) behind your own serving engine when air-gapped or sovereign-cloud requirements demand it  
• Deploy and operate LiteLLM as the model gateway in customer environments: a unified OpenAI-compatible interface across self-hosted open-weight models and hosted providers, with routing, load balancing, retries and fallbacks, rate limits, and per-team virtual keys  
• Instrument and govern LLM usage through the gateway — cost tracking and budgets, caching, logging and observability (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar), and guardrails — so customers can see and control what their AI workloads are doing  
• Wire production observability for everything you ship — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting (e.g. Prometheus + Grafana for metrics, OpenTelemetry for traces, Graylog or ELK for logs — or the customer's existing stack) — so you and the customer's ops team both know what "healthy" looks like and what pages whom when it isn't  
• Design model routing strategies for real-time voice workloads, balancing latency, cost, and quality, with sane fallback behavior when a provider degrades  
• Make the build-vs-buy case between self-hosted open-weight models and hosted frontier APIs, and keep the customer's application code portable across both  
• Adapt models to customer domains: prompt and RAG pipelines and evaluation harnesses for Arabic and English language use cases and KSA/GCC-specific regulatory environments (PDPL, Saudi data localization, cloud sovereignty requirements)  
• Lead POCs, pilots, and production launches from whiteboard to go-live  
• Own customer outcomes — stay engaged until the solution is live and stable  
• Collaborate directly with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap based on field insights from Saudi Arabia and the broader GCC

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration issues alongside customer teams

• CS degree or equivalent experience

• Proficiency in multiple languages: Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go — you're more dangerous in some than others. (Telnyx Edge Compute — functions and stateful actors — is TypeScript, so that one pulls double duty.)  
• Practical understanding of what breaks in front of a model in production: provider rate limits and quotas, timeout and retry behavior, streaming, token accounting and cost attribution, and the failure modes that only show up under concurrency  
• Comfortable deploying containerized services on Kubernetes, with secrets management, config, and upgrades as part of the deployment story  
• You've wired observability and been paged because of it — Prometheus + Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Graylog, ELK, or equivalent. You know what to monitor, what to alert on, and what "healthy" looks like  
• High-concurrency experience — Kafka, message queues, or event streams at real scale. When throughput spikes you know what breaks — consumer lag, backpressure, hot partitions, rebalance stalls — and what absorbs it: partitioning, consumer groups, parallelism up to your partition count  
• You've built APIs from scratch, not just consumed them — OpenAPI spec, REST/GraphQL design, auth, rate limiting, versioning, idempotency

**Position Overview:**

The Senior Manufacturing Test Engineer – Inverter will play a lead role in developing, launching, and sustaining automated test systems for Lucid’s electric traction inverter manufacturing lines. This role is critical to EV power electronics production and focuses on in‑process and end‑of‑line (EOL) testing of high‑voltage inverters to ensure functional performance, safety, efficiency, and long‑term reliability. The engineer will work closely with Design Engineering, Controls, Quality, Production, and external equipment suppliers to deliver robust, scalable, and data‑driven inverter test solutions.

**Responsibilities:**

* Review and approve inverter test specifications and change requests from design engineering, acting as the manufacturing test authority for traction inverter validation.
* Analyze and provide feedback on test sequences, limits, cycle time, process flow, and failure‑mode handling for inverter EOL and sub‑assembly test stations.
* Design and own test system hardware for inverter testing, including system layout, cabinet and rack design, HV/LV routing, connectorization, shielding, grounding, and thermal considerations for high‑power switching electronics.
* Develop modular and scalable test applications with clear operator interfaces for inverter testing, including parameter management, test sequencing, fault messaging, and data logging.
* Implement databases to manage inverter test parameters, serial‑level results, traceability, and correlation to manufacturing and quality systems.
* Define DUT handling, fixturing, and electrical/mechanical interfaces for inverter test stations, including automated HV connections and safety interlocks.
* Collaborate with controls engineers to integrate test applications with station PLCs, dynos or load systems, cooling systems, and material handling equipment, including responses to electrical, thermal, and safety‑critical failure modes.
* Lead sourcing, RFQs, supplier selection, build tracking, and technical oversight for externally supplied inverter test equipment.
* Develop and execute commissioning and validation plans for inverter test systems, including GR&R, red‑rabbit units, fault injection, and simulation of electrical, thermal, and communication failures.
* Launch inverter test systems into production and provide on‑floor support during ramp, including limit tuning, yield improvement, and false‑fail reduction.
* Train maintenance and operations teams on inverter test station operation, error recovery, and safe troubleshooting of high‑voltage power electronics.
* Partner with factory data and analytics teams to enable inverter test data visualization, yield tracking, efficiency trends, and long‑term quality monitoring.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Controls Systems Engineering, Electrical and Controls Engineering, or Automation and Control Engineering and at least 5 years of professional experience
* 5~8 years of experience developing and launching automated test equipment in high‑volume manufacturing environments.
* Direct experience testing EV traction inverters or high‑power power electronics in a manufacturing or production setting.
* Strong understanding of inverter architectures, power stages, gate drivers, DC‑link capacitors, current sensing, and thermal management.
* Hands‑on experience with inverter EOL and in‑process testing such as functional power testing, PWM validation, phase current measurement, switching performance, efficiency testing, isolation resistance, and hipot testing.
* Detailed knowledge of high‑voltage and high‑current electrical components, connectors, cables, shielding, and grounding best practices.
* Ability to design electrical schematics using AutoCAD, EPLAN, or equivalent tools.
* Experience developing test hardware using National Instruments platforms such as PXI, cDAQ, or cRIO.

**Skills:**

* Strong software development experience with NI LabVIEW, NI TestStand, Python, MATLAB, or similar tools used in manufacturing test environments.
* Working knowledge of automotive communication protocols including CAN, CAN‑FD, LIN, and Automotive Ethernet, including inverter diagnostics and calibration interfaces.
* Proficiency using electrical test equipment such as power supplies, electronic loads, oscilloscopes, DMMs, power analyzers, and inverter or power electronics diagnostic tools.
* Experience interfacing test systems with PLCs and industrial networks such as Ethernet/IP or OPC‑UA is a plus.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple inverter test stations, suppliers, and launch timelines in parallel.
* Clear and professional communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, production, quality, and external suppliers.

The Tenant Relationship Manager is responsible for building, curating, and sustaining a high-performing

portfolio of food and beverage operators for Seven Al Hamra Food Hall.

The role ensures that every tenant is successfully onboarded, operationally integrated, commercially

supported, and strategically aligned with the Food Hall’s brand, financial objectives, and customer

promise.

Reporting to the F&B Manager and working closely with the TGP Food Hall Director this role connects commercial curation, tenant performance, and on-site execution, ensuring the right brands

are in the hall, performing well, and delivering an exceptional guest experience.

**Requirements**

**1.Tenant Onboarding & Integration**

\- Design, implement, and continuously improve the Food Hall tenant onboarding program

\- Coordinate with Operations, Facilities, Finance, Marketing, IT, and Compliance to ensure seamless

store openings

\- Guide tenants through all onboarding stages including documentation, systems, training, and

operational readiness

\- Deliver structured tenant orientations covering facilities, systems, SOPs, brand standards, and

policies

\- Review tenant menus, workflows, layouts, and equipment plans to ensure alignment with Food Hall

operations

**2\. Tenant Relationship Management**

\- Act as the main commercial and operational relationship owner for all tenants

\- Maintain regular contact with tenants to monitor performance, satisfaction, and challenges

\- Support menu changes, concept updates, and brand evolution within the Food Hall framework

\- Resolve tenant issues through coordination with Operations, H&S, and Facilities

\- Serve as the first point of contact for new tenancy inquiries and operator engagement

**3\. Performance Monitoring & Reporting**

\- Use operations and POS systems to track tenant sales, orders, revenue, and performance

\- Develop monthly tenant dashboards including:

o Revenue vs budget

o Order volumes

o Trends and variances

\- Translate data into insights and recommendations to improve tenant and Food Hall performance

\- Monitor customer behavior and feedback to identify curation or operational gaps

\- Build growth dashboards showing Food Hall and tenant evolution over time

**4\. Tenant Curation & Portfolio Strategy**

\- Curate a balanced and attractive mix of cuisines, concepts, and price points

\- Apply entry standards for joining the Food Hall

\- Conduct regular curation gap analysis to identify:

o Overperforming and underperforming concepts

o Missing cuisines or customer segments

\- Prioritize onboarding and off-boarding decisions in line with financial and brand objectives

**Job Description:**

Parsons are seeking a highly experienced and motivated **Senior Manager: Rail Systems** to join their team! This is a senior, client‑facing role embedded within an integrated client–PMC office on a major transportation program with a strong focus on rail (metro, heavy rail, light rail, high‑speed). Sitting within the PUA function, the role provides leadership, governance, and integration of all rail systems activities across multiple projects and contracts.

This is a non‑operational position: the focus is on managing and assuring the design and build process on behalf of the client—not running day‑to‑day railway operations or maintenance. The role oversees signalling and train control, telecoms, SCADASCADA, platform systems, automatic fare collection, security and other line‑wide systems, ensuring that all solutions are safe, compliant, interoperable, and aligned with program objectives.

## What You'll Be Doing;

* Act as the program‑level lead for rail systems within PUA, setting direction and priorities for rail systems across all relevant projects.
* Develop and maintain rail systems strategies, standards, and technical principles aligned with the client’s vision, regulatory requirements, and interoperability objectives.
* Ensure employer’s requirements for rail systems are clear, consistent, and properly reflected in contracts, scopes of work, and design briefs.
* Provide independent, strategic advice to senior client leadership on rail systems issues, risks, opportunities, and long‑term implications.
* Oversee rail systems scope across multiple projects and packages (signalling, telecoms, SCADASCADA, platform systems, AFC, security, control centres, line‑wide systems).
* Coordinate and align project‑level rail systems managers and engineers to ensure consistent technical approaches, assumptions, and interfaces.
* Review and challenge project plans for rail systems design, procurement, installation, testing, and commissioning to ensure realism and alignment with program milestones.
* Drive resolution of cross‑project rail systems issues and conflicts, escalating to PUA and program leadership as required.
* Oversee the rail systems technical assurance framework at program level, ensuring adherence to:
    * Employer’s requirements and performance specifications
    * Local regulatory and authority requirements
    * International and industry
* Provide senior review and approval (on behalf of the client) of key rail systems design concepts, architectures, and key technical decisions.
* Ensure that requirements management, verification, and validation processes for rail systems are properly applied and evidenced.
* Support and, where necessary, chair high‑level technical and design review boards for critical rail systems decisions.
* Provide program‑level oversight of systems integration across:
    * Signalling/train control and rolling stock
    * Rail systems and civil/MEP/architectural works (rooms, routes, environmental conditions)
    * Central control centres and operational systems
    * External systems (utilities, communications providers, legacy or adjacent rail networks)
* Ensure that interface management processes and tools (interface registers, interface agreements) are consistently applied across all contracts.
* Drive resolution of major interface issues that cross project boundaries, ensuring integrated, end‑to‑end solutions that support operational concepts.
* Provide leadership on rail systems safety and RAMS at program level, in coordination with Engineering & Safety and PUA governance.
* Oversee rail systems safety cases, hazard logs, RAMS analyses, and related evidence, ensuring consistency and sufficiency for regulatory approvals.
* Coordinate with independent safety assessors, notified bodies, and regulators to plan and achieve rail systems safety approvals and certifications.
* Ensure cyber‑security requirements for critical rail systems are defined and properly integrated into contracts, designs, and assurance evidence.
* Provide program‑level oversight of rail systems testing & commissioning strategies and schedules.
* Ensure alignment of rail systems FAT, SAT, static and dynamic tests, integration tests, and trial operations across multiple projects.
* Review readiness for key program milestones (e.g., power‑on, system integration testing, trial operations, EIS) from a rail systems perspective.
* Support the client in defining and applying acceptance criteria for rail systems and in making go/no‑go recommendations for EIS.
* Work with program controls and risk teams to ensure that key rail systems activities, risks, and constraints are reflected in the integrated master schedule and risk registers.
* Identify and manage program‑level rail systems risks and opportunities, including technology, integration, safety, approvals, and supplier performance.
* Review and advise on major changes, variations, and value engineering proposals that affect rail systems scope, performance, and lifecycle costs.
* Provide concise, high‑quality reporting and briefings to program governance bodies on rail systems progress, risk, and decision needs.
* Coordinate with internal client stakeholders (Operations, Maintenance, Safety, IT, Commercial, Customer Experience) to ensure rail systems support operational concepts and service levels.
* Work closely with future operators/maintainers to incorporate operational requirements and maintenance strategies into rail systems design and acceptance.
* Engage with regulators, transport authorities, and adjacent infrastructure owners where rail systems interface with external networks or shared assets.
* Support communication with external stakeholders where rail systems technology, safety, or performance is a key concern.
* Lead and mentor rail systems managers and engineers within the integrated client–PMC environment; foster a high‑performance, collaborative culture.
* Build capability in rail systems and systems integration within the PUA and client teams, including training, knowledge sharing, and lessons learned.
* Promote best practice in rail systems engineering, integration, and assurance across all projects.
* Contribute to succession planning and long‑term capability development for rail systems disciplines.

## What You'll Bring;

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Telecommunications, Control/Systems Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Master’s degree in Railway Systems, Transportation Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Project/Program Management is an advantage.
* Professional registration/chartership (e.g., CEng, PE, or equivalent) is highly desirable.
* Project/program management certification is an advantage.
* 15+ years’ experience in rail systems engineering on major rail/metro/light rail/high‑speed rail programs.
* Significant experience in a PMC, client organization, or major consultancy, including program‑ or portfolio‑level rail systems responsibility.
* Proven track record in systems integration, technical assurance, RAMS, and safety certification for rail systems.
* Demonstrated experience working within integrated client/PMC environments and leading multi‑disciplinary teams and multiple contractors/OEMs.
* Experience across multiple delivery phases (design, procurement, installation, testing & commissioning, EIS) is essential.
* Deep technical understanding of rail systems architectures and technologies (signalling/train control, telecoms, SCADA, platform systems, AFC, security, control centres).
* Strong knowledge of systems engineering, integration, and RAMS processes (including CENELEC norms for safety‑related systems).
* Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, and influencing skills at senior levels.
* Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem‑solving abilities; able to balance technical, commercial, and program considerations.
* Highly effective communication and presentation skills; able to convey complex issues clearly to non‑technical decision‑makers.
* Solid understanding of program controls (time, cost, risk) and how rail systems activities impact them.
* High level of professionalism, integrity, and commitment to client outcomes.

description:
At Air Products, we reimagine what’s possible. By tapping into the motivation of our people and our collective experience, we create the ideas and innovations that drive us forward. When we come together – where every voice is heard and everyone knows they belong and matter – we create solutions that launch people into space, support lifesaving care in hospitals, and enable the construction of groundbreaking, world scale production facilities.

  

**Reimagine What’s Possible** 

  
  

**Purpose**

The Senior Process Engineer – HYCO provides senior-level technical leadership for ongoing plant operations and projects—from concept development through commissioning and start-up—and leads asset management and productivity initiatives across all BHIG operating facilities in the Region. The role coordinates technical activities between site-based engineers and operations teams, mentors junior process engineers, and ensures safe, reliable, efficient and cost-effective production of hydrogen, syngas, CO and CO₂.

**Nature & Scope**

Reporting to the BHIG Engineering Manager, the Senior Process Engineer – HYCO provides day-to-day operational and technical support to Regional Sites through systematic monitoring of plant performance to ensure that production, energy efficiency, and reliability targets are consistently achieved in a safe manner. As a senior technical authority, the incumbent acts as a subject-matter expert (SME) on HYCO process technology and mentors site-based process engineers.

The role identifies productivity opportunities, develops engineering solutions, and supports the project execution teams across multiple technologies: Air Separation Units (ASU), Hydrogen / Syngas (HYCO – SMR based), and CO₂ production. The incumbent may also support Air Products plant support teams in providing similar services to JV partners, equipment sales customers and new prospects.

This position interfaces with Air Products global, regional and local process / production engineers, Regional Operations team members, project and design engineering teams, process safety specialists, and other technical support personnel. The role helps implement the systems and measures required to meet BHIG's Middle East operational requirements, technical standards, quality processes and plant & equipment integrity programs.

The incumbent will coordinate and effectively utilize global operating and technical resources to support existing operations, new installations and modifications led by BHIG Project Engineering or by the Air Products Global Engineering & Manufacturing Organization. The position will help drive consistency in operations across the Middle East Region and contribute to the continuous improvement of productivity, reliability, quality, process safety, and cost-effectiveness of the plants—using BHIG and Air Products systems, tools, statistical techniques and Continuous Improvement methodologies. Developing and tracking plant performance and reliability KPIs is an integral part of the role.

**Principal Accountabilities**

**Safety**

* Provide and maintain a safe work environment for self and others; demonstrate visible safety leadership.
* Participate in meetings with government departments responsible for safety, environmental, fire protection and public security oversight, and ensure timely implementation of applicable requirements within BHIG.
* Participate in major turnarounds and project activities, ensuring safety throughout execution.
* Coordinate employee safety committee meetings and programs and actively encourage employee participation and accountability in safety management programs.

**Technical**

* Act as senior technical authority and subject-matter expert for HYCO process engineering across the Region; mentor and coach junior and site-based process engineers, and provide peer review on key engineering deliverables.
* Lead and provide technical support to regional teams for new installations, existing plant modifications, on-going operations, and continuous improvement and maintenance activities for BHIG, equipment sales and potential new customers. Support is delivered through site visits, remote phone / video support, or via the Process Intelligence Center (PIC). Ensure all activities comply with legal requirements, BHIG safety and technical standards.
* Provide technical support and safety leadership for Management of Change (MOC), Operational/Process Hazard Reviews (OPHR), PHA / HAZOP, LOPA and other process safety related initiatives in order to drive PSM compliance. Consult BHIG and Air Products process safety specialists as required.
* Provide process engineering leadership to drive asset performance, reduce operating costs and increase plant throughput by supporting: troubleshooting, plant efficiency studies, process safety, equipment reliability, advanced process control (APC), asset management, and productivity project identification, development and execution.
* Apply process statistics and data analytics (control charts, regression, capability analysis, multivariate analysis) to detect performance drift, quantify variability, prioritize improvement opportunities and validate the impact of implemented changes.
* Develop, maintain and validate steady-state and dynamic process simulation models in Aspen Plus (and associated Aspen suite tools) to support troubleshooting, performance benchmarking, debottlenecking, what-if studies, energy optimization, and revamp / new project evaluations.
* Provide expert technical support on heterogeneous catalyst systems used in HYCO / Hydrogen plants—including Hydrodesulfurization (HDS), ZnO sulfur absorbers, Pre-Reforming, Steam Methane Reforming (SMR), High-Temperature Shift (HTS), Low-Temperature Shift (LTS) and Methanation—covering activity / deactivation assessment, kinetic and equilibrium evaluation, poison management, life-cycle prediction, change-out strategy, vendor selection and performance auditing.
* Facilitate operational excellence through continuous improvement in plant productivity, reliability, quality and cost; lead improvements and ensure that best practices are deployed.
* Provide technical leadership in investigations and Root Cause Analyses (RCA) in order to identify and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* Provide technical support for Advanced Process Control (APC) and real-time optimization (RTO) initiatives.
* Monitor plant production daily, driving asset performance and ensuring daily targets are met to maximize profitability and customer satisfaction.

**Operations**

* Provide process engineering support to operations in order to safely and reliably operate, SMR-based HYCO and CO₂ facilities in the Region, meeting customer expectations on safety, reliability, product quality and supply flexibility while remaining compliant with contractual requirements.
* Ensure that BHIG standards and Air Products global best practices for EH&S, productivity, reliability, quality and customer service are met.
* Provide technical guidance to commissioning teams, supporting commissioning, start-up and troubleshooting activities.
* Participate in the training of the Operations team up to plant commissioning, including catalyst loading, reduction / activation and start-up of SMR, Shift and Methanation reactors.
* Participate in developing the month-end close model and ensure alignment with commercial obligations for the BHIG Middle East Commercial Area.
* Maintain close working relationships with engineering and maintenance personnel to continuously monitor and evaluate plant systems and equipment through a Plant Process Advisory model.
* Support Process Intelligence Center (PIC) initiatives such as plant monitoring, troubleshooting, plant simulation training sessions, plant modelling and plant efficiency monitoring.
* Maintain alignment with Plant Managers, Site Leadership and the Business Area on asset management opportunities and commercial priorities.
* Provide technical support for turnarounds, including catalyst inspection, sampling, change-out planning and post-turnaround performance validation.

**Minimum Requirements and Qualifications**

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering (Master's degree is a plus).
* Minimum 12+ years of experience in Engineering and/or Operations in a senior technical role within the industrial gases, refining, petrochemical (Methanol and ammonia) or hydrogen production industry.
* Demonstrated experience and knowledge of the technology, design and operation of Steam Methane Reformers (HYCO) and CO₂ production systems is preferred. Single-technology expertise will be considered; multi-technology background is strongly preferred at this senior level.
* Proven track record of start-up, commissioning and plant operating experience.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring junior engineers and leading multi-disciplinary technical teams.

**Technical Skills**

* **Process Simulation –** Strong proficiency in Aspen Plus) for steady-state and dynamic modelling of HYCO, ASU and CO₂ processes; capable of building, calibrating and using rigorous models for plant performance evaluation, troubleshooting and optimization.
* **Process Statistics & Data Analytics –** Working knowledge of statistical methods applied to process engineering: SPC / control charts, regression and correlation analysis, capability studies (Cp / Cpk), and multivariate / time-series analysis. Familiarity with tools such as Minitab, PI Datalink.
* **Heterogeneous Catalysis –** Solid technical understanding of heterogeneous catalysts used in hydrogen / syngas production, including Hydrodesulfurization (HDS / CoMo, NiMo), ZnO sulfur guards, Pre-reforming, Steam Methane Reforming (SMR), High-Temperature Shift (HTS – Fe/Cr), Low-Temperature Shift (LTS – Cu/Zn/Al) and Methanation (Ni based). This includes reaction kinetics and thermodynamics, activation / reduction procedures, deactivation and poisoning mechanisms, performance monitoring, life prediction and change-out strategy.
* **Process Safety –** Knowledgeable in Process Safety Management (PSM), PHA / HAZOP, LOPA, MOC, OPHR, and applicable local EHS regulations.
* **Advanced Process Control & Optimization –** Familiarity with APC, RTO and energy optimization concepts for hydrogen and ASU plants.
* **Engineering Tools –** Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), data historians (e.g., OSIsoft PI / AVEVA PI), and standard process engineering calculation tools.

**Leadership & Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong commitment to employee involvement, team building, diversity and inclusion.
* Proven ability to mentor and coach less experienced engineers and to act as a recognized technical reference within the organization.
* Able to communicate effectively across management, operations, maintenance and customer interfaces within and across regions.
* Proficiency in English (spoken and written) is required; Arabic language skills are a plus.
* Demonstrated leadership, organizational, computer and interpersonal skills.
* Personal commitment to continuous self-development and flexibility to work outside normal hours to meet operational and project commitments.
* Excellent influencing skills, ability to build trust and confidence with frontline workers, supervisors and management.
* Strong critical thinking, problem-solving and analytical skills are prerequisites.
* Confident, assertive, self-motivated and results oriented.
* Personal commitment to corporate values and to a culture of continuous improvement.
* Formal training and experience with Six Sigma (Green / Black Belt) and Continuous Improvement tools is a plus.

The Senior Presales Solutions Architect is responsible for leading the technical presales lifecycle for opportunities involving digital solutions, enterprise platforms, microservices, artificial intelligence, data, analytics, business intelligence and telecom solutions.

The role works closely with sales, delivery, product, architecture, finance, partners and customers to understand business needs, define suitable solution approaches, design robust technical architectures, prepare high-quality technical proposals, estimate implementation efforts and present proposed solutions to executive, business and technical stakeholders.

The position requires strong technical architecture capabilities, telecom industry knowledge, proposal development experience, commercial awareness, stakeholder management and customer presentation skills.

**1\. Opportunity Qualification and Presales Planning**

* Review customer opportunities, RFPs, RFIs, tenders, statements of work and business requirements.
* Assess opportunities from technical, delivery, resource, commercial and strategic perspectives.
* Participate in Go/No-Go evaluations and provide clear technical recommendations.
* Identify missing information, dependencies, risks, assumptions and clarification questions.
* Develop presales response plans, technical workstreams, responsibilities and submission timelines.
* Coordinate with sales, PMO, delivery, finance, legal, cybersecurity and external partners.

* Translate business requirements into functional and non-functional technical requirements.

* Define suitable use cases across digital solutions, microservices, AI, data, BI and telecom domains.

* Ensure requirements are clear, measurable, traceable and aligned with the proposed solution.
* Prepare requirement-traceability and compliance matrices.
* Validate requirements with business, technical, security and operational stakeholders.

**3\. Digital Solution Architecture**

* Design end-to-end digital solution architectures covering enterprise portals, web applications, mobile applications, content management, workflows, integration, data, security, infrastructure and operations.

* Recommend suitable technologies, frameworks, platforms and architectural patterns.
* Ensure proposed solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, maintainable, observable and cost-effective.
* Design solutions for cloud, on-premises, hybrid and sovereign deployment environments.
* Define availability, performance, scalability, backup and disaster-recovery requirements.

* Define reusable components and shared technical services.

**4\. Microservices and Integration Architecture**

* Design microservices-based architectures using domain-driven design, API-first principles and event-driven patterns.

Job Description

WSP in the Middle East are seeking a Principal / Associate Electrical - Airport Project Experience to lead the design and delivery of complex aviation and industrial buildings—including aircraft maintenance hangars, engine/APU workshops, and large-scale flight catering environments.
