Lead electrical design from feasibility and Basis of Design (BoD) through detailed design, tender and construction support for aviation facilities.
Own the electrical power strategy for large-scale facilities (e.g., hangar bays): MV/LV distribution, redundancy, load management, earthing, and control philosophies—balancing reliability, safety, and energy performance (IEC/NFPA context).
Engineer electrical systems for hazardous operations: paint booths/rooms, fuel-cell maintenance areas, welding zones—ensuring compliance with ATEX/IECEx and coordination with mechanical ventilation and controls.
Design and specify power systems for aviation facilities: transformers, generators, UPS, distribution boards, and backup systems for mission-critical operations.
Integrate electrical utilities across MRO and workshop environments—ground power units (GPU), PCA interfaces, process equipment loads, and coordination with mechanical, fire/life safety, and control systems.
Shape electrical systems for catering facilities: resilient power distribution for kitchens, cold-chain systems, and hygienic areas aligned with HACCP/ISO 22000 requirements.
Deliver BIM-led coordination (Revit/Navisworks) across architecture, structures, MEP, and specialist systems; lead clash resolution and model QA.
Perform calculations and studies: load estimation, cable sizing, protection coordination, short-circuit analysis, and lighting design.
Author technical documents: BoD, load schedules, single-line diagrams (SLDs), specifications, and commissioning plans.
Mentor and review engineers/designers; lead design reviews, HAZOPs, and constructability/operability workshops.
Engage stakeholders—airlines, MROs, airport operators, and authorities—to secure approvals and ensure smooth delivery.
Lead retrofit, refurbishment, and brownfield upgrades in operational airport environments—assessing existing systems, planning phased upgrades, and integrating new systems with minimal disruption while improving capacity, compliance, and energy performance.
Key systems & domains you’ll cover

Hangars & workshops: MV/LV distribution, ground power units (GPU), PCA electrical interfaces, high-bay lighting, emergency power, earthing and bonding for aircraft safety, and hangar door electrics.
Paint/corrosion control: hazardous-area electrical systems, explosion-proof equipment, interlocks, LEL monitoring interfaces, and ATEX/IECEx compliance coordinated with ventilation and controls.
Welding & fabrication: power distribution for welding equipment, equipment earthing, task lighting, and integration with extraction/LEV systems aligned with OSHA/ACGIH guidance.
Power systems: transformers, generators, UPS, LV panels, and distribution networks designed for redundancy, resilience, and mission-critical operations.
Catering facilities: resilient power supply for kitchens, cold rooms/freezers, food processing areas, and hygienic zoning aligned with HACCP/ISO 22000 requirements.
ELV & controls: fire alarm systems (NFPA 72), ICT, security (CCTV/access control), structured cabling, and BMS/SCADA integration for operational monitoring and control.

Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering; Master's degree preferred.
Professionally registered (CEng, PE, or equivalent).
15+ years' experience in electrical building services design, including aviation and complex infrastructure projects.
Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary design teams and delivering major projects.

Technical Expertise
Strong knowledge of international electrical design codes, standards, and aviation requirements.
Expertise in MV/LV power distribution, load assessments, protection systems, and earthing design.
Proficiency in BIM and industry-standard design software, including Revit, Navisworks, ETAP, and Dialux.
Experience in airport facilities, terminal buildings, and aviation-related infrastructure is highly desirable.

## Job Description

At SLS The Red Sea, every detail contributes to creating exceptional guest experiences. As a **Laundry & Kitchen Technician**, you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of the resort’s kitchen and laundry equipment through effective maintenance, timely repairs, and proactive technical support.

Working as part of the Engineering team, you will support daily operations by maintaining critical equipment, identifying potential issues, and delivering reliable solutions that allow our Culinary, Laundry, and Operations teams to perform at the highest standards while ensuring safety, quality, and operational excellence.

* Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on all kitchen and laundry equipment to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operation.
* Inspect, troubleshoot, and repair commercial kitchen equipment including ovens, combi ovens, fryers, grills, steamers, dishwashers, refrigeration units, and extraction systems.
* Maintain laundry equipment including washers, dryers, ironing machines, and other related operational systems.
* Conduct regular equipment inspections to identify faults, leaks, abnormal performance, or potential failures before they impact operations.

description:
Job Identification: 217547
Job Category: Sales and Marketing
Job Schedule: Full time
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Commercial Manager , you’re not leading commercial strategy across multiple segments and revenue streams – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
Here's what you'll do during a typical day:
+ Own commercial strategy and execution: Develop and implement integrated commercial strategies across all revenue streams — including Group, Conference, and Events (GCE), Rooms, Food and Beverage, Leisure, and Spa — to drive top-line performance and market share growth
+ Maximize revenue and profitability: Partner with General Managers and Finance to ensure commercial decisions support revenue goals, optimize cost of sales, and deliver profit and margin targets
+ Lead pricing and forecasting strategy: Oversee revenue management practices including pricing, rate strategies, demand forecasting, and business reviews to optimize revenue across all segments
+ Align sales and marketing efforts: Coordinate on-property and regional sales, marketing, eCommerce, and public relations activities to support brand positioning and drive demand
+ Adapt to market dynamics: Monitor trends, assess competitive landscape, and adjust commercial strategies to stay ahead in evolving market conditions
+ Strengthen stakeholder relationships: Build trusted relationships with owners, operators, Hilton corporate teams, and external partners to align goals and create long-term commercial value
+ Cultivate a high-performing team: Drive engagement and retention through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs
What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
How We’ll Help You Thrive
At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:
Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Through our Care for All hub, we provide resources to help our Team Members to care for themselves and their loved ones. In many countries, eligible Team Members receive free counseling and support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
*Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.
Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture
At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands (https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/) , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog (https://jobs.hilton.com/blogs) to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

We are looking for a **Data Analyst** to work closely with the Data Architect, Technical Data Lead, Business Analysts, ETL Developers, BI Developers, Platform Administrators, and business stakeholders.  

The Data Analyst will play a key role in understanding business requirements, analyzing existing data structures and processes, validating data, defining analytical requirements, and supporting the transition toward the company’s target data architecture.  

The role requires a strong combination of **business analysis, data analysis, SQL, data quality, reporting, and data visualization** skills, with the ability to translate business questions into reliable, actionable data insights.  

YOU WILL  

»       Analyze business requirements and translate them into clear data and analytical requirements.  

»       Work with stakeholders to understand business processes, KPIs, reporting requirements, and data needs.  

»       Analyze existing data sources, ODS, DWH, staging, data marts, and reporting environments.  

»       Profile and assess data to identify quality issues, duplication, inconsistencies, missing values, and data anomalies.  

»       Investigate existing reports, dashboards, calculations, and business logic to ensure they are correctly understood before migration or redesign.  

»       Define and document data requirements, source-to-target mappings, business rules, and transformation logic.  

»       Develop complex SQL queries for data extraction, reconciliation, validation, and analysis.  

»       Support the Data Architect in assessing current-state data architecture and defining requirements for the target-state platform.  

»       Work with ETL/ELT teams to validate data pipelines and transformation logic.  

»       Perform source-to-target reconciliation and data validation during migration activities.  

»       Support data migration and coexistence activities between legacy and target platforms.  

»       Analyze data from Oracle, DWH, ODS, MDM, BI, and other enterprise data platforms.  

»       Work with data integration patterns including batch, CDC, APIs, and file-based ingestion from an analytical and business perspective.  

»       Develop and maintain analytical datasets, data marts, and semantic-layer requirements.  

»       Work with BI developers to define and validate dashboards, reports, KPIs, and semantic models.  

»       Support Power BI and other BI solutions by validating metrics, dimensions, measures, and business calculations.  

»       Define and document data quality rules and support data quality monitoring.  

»       Assist with metadata, data lineage, data ownership, and business glossary activities.  

»       Identify opportunities to simplify reporting, eliminate redundant data processes, and improve data usage.  

»       Support regulatory, management, operational, and enterprise reporting requirements.  

»       Ensure analytical requirements are aligned with data governance, security, and regulatory requirements.  

»       Support the preparation of data for advanced analytics, machine learning, and future AI/LLM use cases.  

»       Communicate analytical findings and data issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.  

»       Contribute to data standards, documentation, and best practices across the organization.  

  

  
### Requirements

»       TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THE ROLE YOU NEED  

»       Strong experience as a Data Analyst, BI Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, or similar data-focused role.  

»       Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases, preferably Oracle or similar enterprise database platforms.  

»       Good understanding of ODS, DWH, data marts, lakehouse, semantic layers, ETL/ELT, and BI architectures.  

»       Experience with data profiling, reconciliation, validation, and data quality analysis.

»       Experience with Power BI or similar visualization and BI platforms.  

»       Understanding of enterprise data platforms and technologies such as Informatica, GoldenGate, MDM, DQ, EDC/Axon, or equivalent technologies is an advantage.  

»       Experience working with cloud and modern data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, Azure, AWS, or GCP is an advantage.  

»       Understanding of CDC, data integration, metadata, lineage, data governance, and data security.  

»       Ability to investigate complex data problems and identify the root cause of inconsistencies.  

»       Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to data analysis.  

»       Ability to communicate effectively with business users, developers, architects, and senior stakeholders.  

»       Experience working in financial services, banking, insurance, or other regulated industries is a strong advantage.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Senior Cost Engineer – Airport Infrastructure** to join our team! In this role you will get to lead cost planning, budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and performance reporting across major airport and infrastructure projects. You will provide accurate and timely cost information, evaluate changes and commercial impacts, and support project leadership in maintaining financial control throughout the full project lifecycle.  


## What You'll Be Doing

* Develop and maintain project cost estimates, approved budgets, cost plans, and cost control baselines.
* Support the preparation of project funding requirements and phased expenditure plans.
* Monitor budget utilization and identify potential cost overruns, underruns, and emerging variances.
* Ensure cost information is aligned with the project scope, Work Breakdown Structure (WBS), control accounts, and work packages.
* Support project leadership in maintaining effective financial control throughout design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout.
* Monitor committed costs, actual expenditures, accruals, forecasts, and anticipated final costs against approved budgets.
* Analyze project cost performance and identify trends, risks, opportunities, and areas requiring corrective action.
* Prepare detailed cost variance analyses and recommend appropriate mitigation and recovery measures.
* Support the implementation of consistent cost control processes across all project packages and disciplines.
* Prepare periodic cost forecasts, including Estimate at Completion (EAC) and Estimate to Complete (ETC).
* Develop monthly cost reports, dashboards, expenditure profiles, and management presentations.
* Monitor project cash flow requirements and support financial planning and funding reviews.
* Provide accurate and timely cost information to support project and executive-level decision-making.
* Evaluate the cost implications of design changes, variations, scope modifications, and emerging project requirements.
* Review contractor variation submissions, quotations, and change requests from a cost engineering perspective.
* Prepare cost impact assessments, commercial evaluations, and recommendations for management review.
* Maintain change registers and track approved, pending, and forecast variations against project budgets.
* Support the commercial team in monitoring and managing overall project cost exposure.
* Provide cost engineering support across major airport development components, including:
* Passenger terminals
* Runways and taxiways
* Cargo aprons and aircraft stands
* Roads and external infrastructure
* Utility networks
